transcript.text: Alright, everyone, before we finalize the arrangement for our two spring sing-along rehearsals at the community hall, I'd like to do our routine planning check-in. Felix, Rosa, and Gabe — in turn, please each state any proposal, offer, or hall requirement relevant to our arrangement so I can review everything before making my final decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My proposal is to accompany two rehearsals on May 14 and May 16 from 18:00 to 20:00, in exchange for three 45-minute private voice-coaching sessions from Inez, with no cash payment.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a confirmed alternative offer from pianist Dana, who would provide the same two evening rehearsals for exactly $300 cash.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to state a hall requirement: the hall's acoustic piano must be used for the choir's rehearsals, because amplified instruments and brought-in keyboards are prohibited during the choir's rehearsals. Whoever accompanies will need to play the hall's own piano.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Felix will accompany two rehearsals on May 14 and May 16 from 18:00 to 20:00 at the community hall, playing the hall's acoustic piano.
Inez will provide Felix with three 45-minute private voice-coaching sessions in exchange, with no cash payment.
Felix must use the hall's own acoustic piano, as amplified instruments and brought-in keyboards are prohibited during choir rehearsals.
